question: Should the reconnect-error contract be rebased through this conflicted branch, or reimplemented as a narrower patch on current main's rewritten iOS onboarding surface?
rationale: The desired behavior is established, but current main has changed the owning onboarding flow enough that choosing the safest integration path requires iOS owner judgment.

options.title: Rebase and finish this PR
options.body: Resolve the semantic conflicts against current main, repair the two remaining state transitions, and preserve the existing regression work.

options.title: Replace with a narrow patch
options.body: Pause this branch and reimplement the status contract directly on current main if conflict resolution would retain too much obsolete onboarding structure.
